title: The Parturient Blessed Morality of Physiological Dimensionality: Aleph-Null Number
medium: India ink, vinyl press type, and collage on board

said.q: I prefer to use ‘C’ to stand for consciousness.
said.via: International Studio & Curatorial Program Benefit Auction, on Artsy

said.q: Dividing the composition into different sections, he explores the connection between human physiology and dimensionality through a range of textual and visual symbols on the left and right sides of the work. A navel orange, reminiscent of the Fibonacci spiral, marks the middle of work and a column with the letter ‘C’ at various numerical powers runs down center, representing light at the top and dark at the bottom.
